capabilities: Search companies by name or ticker across multiple markets
List available financial reports for a matched stock
Save selected reports into the vault as Markdown notes with headings, tables and unit notes
extras: Freemium: free tier without a key (31 reports/7 days/IP), free key tier (8,191 reports/7 days), and a paid yearly tier; includes a PayPal referral payout program. Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search and import full-text regulatory financial filings (10-K, annual and quarterly reports) from exchanges and regulators as readable Markdown notes.
summary: Financial report fetcher that searches companies by name or ticker and saves full-text annual, semi-annual, quarterly and 10-K reports into the vault as Markdown notes.
